description: This file defines the WorkShiftDecorator class, which provides a decorator pattern for WorkShift objects. It adds methods to format start and end times of a work shift into string representations and utilizes helper traits for ORM and DateTime functionalities.

classes.name: WorkShiftDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps a WorkShift entity to provide additional formatting methods for start and end times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a WorkShift object.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the work shift formatted as a time string, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the work shift formatted as a time string, or null if unavailable.
